scope: Local operation needs no owned public domain. Prove loopback/origin/cache boundaries and document optional TLS/private ingress without exposing engine work by default (Requirement N32).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C32-owned implementation, test, fixture, documentation and packaging-wiring paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only README/START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/ to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic network boundaries, negative scenarios and expected output contracts; contains no real credential, provider state or plaintext secret.

commands.summary: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
35 web and contract tests passed, including DNS rebinding defense via Host validation, same-origin API enforcement, cache-control segregation, and engine loopback isolation.
All Go packages passed; engine lifecycle, internal auth, vaults, storage, and domain integration passed.
Validated JSON files, OpenAPI 3.2.0, AsyncAPI 3.1.0, and repository invariants.
Five complete-release integration tests passed with updated resources including infra/deployment.md.

invariants_verified.loopback_isolation: Enforced; web and engine bind to loopback interfaces (127.0.0.1, ::1); external binds fail closed.
invariants_verified.dns_rebinding_defense: Enforced; foreign Host headers rejected with 400 invalid_host.
invariants_verified.origin_boundary: Enforced; untrusted cross-origin requests to /api rejected with 403 cross_origin_forbidden.
invariants_verified.cache_boundaries: Enforced; sensitive and dynamic routes emit Cache-Control: no-store and Pragma: no-cache; static assets emit public, max-age=31536000, immutable.
invariants_verified.engine_isolation: Enforced; Go engine communicates solely via loopback proxy on ephemeral port; direct external exposure is prohibited.
invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao seals and owns secret bytes; Keycloak manages identity and fresh step-up tokens; provider outage fails closed with 503.
